title: Alexa Python Development: Build and Deploy an Alexa Skill
description: Become an Alexa Python developer by building and deploying your own Alexa skill, a joke bot that responds to voice commands on Amazon Alexa devices.
summary: Smart home speakers were a novel idea just a couple of years ago. Today, they’ve become a central part of many people’s homes and offices and their adoption is only expected to grow.
takeaways: In this tutorial, you’ll become an Alexa Python developer by deploying your own Alexa skill, an application that users will interact with using voice commands to Amazon Alexa devices.

Understanding Alexa Skills An Alexa Python developer must be familiar with a number of different Alexa skill components, but the two most important components are the interface and the service : The skill interface processes the user’s speech inputs and maps it to an intent.
The skill service contains all the business logic that determines the response for a given user input and returns it as a JSON object.
